program.name: Phase 1 Scaffold
program.description: Structural skeleton for Keki: pnpm monorepo, Drizzle schema, Cognito/Postgres auth split, four Next.js route groups, SST-provisioned AWS resources, async workers, and CI — with no booking, payment, waiver, or marketing logic.

successCriteria.description: pnpm dev runs the Next.js application locally.
sst dev links the application to its AWS resources.
Neon migrations run successfully using the direct connection string.
Placeholder customer, kiosk, staff, and admin routes all load.
staff/ and admin/ routes require authentication and reject an unauthorized role.
Every shared package compiles independently (pnpm -r typecheck passes).
Vitest and Playwright both run in CI.
A sample message published to SQS is consumed by its deployed worker.
Environment setup is documented in the repository README.
All thirteen Drizzle tables exist with generated, applied migrations.
All five integration interfaces are defined and referenced, with no production implementation.
The four roles exist, with Cognito holding identity and Postgres holding profile and role assignment.
Application traffic uses the pooled connection string and migrations use the direct one, configured as separate secrets.
Every SQS queue has a DLQ and a CloudWatch failure alarm.

packages.name: web

packages.name: contracts
packages.description: Shared domain types, validation schemas, role constants, and the five typed integration interfaces.

packages.name: ui
